notes.title: The PIXELJAM COMPLETE Megabundle + DLC Supporter Packs Are Live
notes.content:
Hello all,

Yesterday we launched [b]PIXELJAM COMPLETE[/b], a massive collection that brings together 14 years of our creative output in a single bundle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6883465/52afdd3b33033872257b632aab4595fb34aa93bf.png[/img]

[list]
[*] 20+ games & soundtracks
[*] Prototypes & alphas from projects we never finished
[*] Wallpapers, design sketches, art, gifs, comics, music & more
[/list]

[b]You can find it here: [url=https://pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete]pixeljam.itch.io/pixeljam-complete[/url][/b]

In tandem with this bundle, we are also rolling out "supporter packs" for each of our games on Steam, that contain sketches, concept art, gifs, wallpapers & soundtracks:

(click each game for its supporter pack)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159130/Cheap_Golf_SUSAN_Supporter_Pack/]Cheap Golf[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/335170/Potatoman_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Potatoman Seeks The Troof[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/383140/Glorkian_Warrior_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Glorkian Warrior[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/424950/Last_Horizon_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Last Horizon[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/510800/Dino_Run_DX_OST/]Dino Run DX[/url]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159270/Gamma_Bros_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Gamma Bros[/url] (Launches Oct 21)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1160350/Snowball_OST__Supporter_Pack/]Snowball![/url] (Launches Oct 21)

If you just want the goodies for 1 or 2 of our games, the Steam DLC's are the way to go.  However, each of them are only about 1% of the total contents of the Pixeljam Complete bundle, which is overall a much better value.

Also, if you'd like to help boost our launch signal, [url=https://twitter.com/pixeljamgames/status/1184125853371949056]click here[/url].

Thanks for the ongoing support!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: -SPEEDRUN MODE ADDED-
notes.content:
Another week, another update...  version 1.11 now has SPEEDRUN MODE, which means:

[list]
[*] No cutscenes
[*] A single timer for the entire episode
[*] A new speedrun leaderboard for each episode
[/list]

Your time will only submit to Steam if you make it to the very end of the episode, of course.

If you'd like to help us spread the word:

https://twitter.com/Cheap__Golf/status/1064628770433363970

We hope you enjoy the new feature!  More stuff in the works, including [b]Episode 4[/b] and [b]weekly challenges[/b].

[i]-Miles @ Pixeljam[/i]

notes.title: Camera Hotfix - Version 1.0.4 Live
notes.content:
We just uploaded a new version (1.0.4) that addresses zooming/camera issues in 1.0.3 when dragging the flinger outside of the play area.  It should work much smoother now.

-Miles @ Pixeljam

notes.title: -Episode 2: Cryptofutures Is Out Now-
notes.content:
Hello All,

We just released Episode 2!  It should be in your current version of the game (1.0.3).  We also made the following updates:

- Camera zooms out a little smoother
- Episode 1 levels got a few changes (mostly difficulty tweaks)
- Slight improvements to the editor, but it still has a ways to go
- Slo-mo threshold was reduced, so you should see it more (slo-mo is enabled when you fling a ball while it's still moving)

We also added 2 new leaderboards (for Ep. 1 + 2) and one new achievement.

We also promise it will not take a whole extra year for Episode 3 (and full release) to arrive.  We are well underway on that - current estimation is about 2-3 months.

Enjoy!

-Miles @ Pixeljam

PS - The Linux version of Episode 2 is a bit behind and should be available within the week.

notes.title: Quick update - level balancing & upcoming tweaks
notes.content:
Hello all,

Today we uploaded a quick adjustment to the difficulty of a few levels in the game (specifically WAT and QWEST), in an attempt to smooth out the difficulty spikes.  The spikes are intentional and part of the story, but some levels are still a bit too spiky and can tend to be more frustrating than challenging.

We would rather people see the end of Episode 1 than rage quit, so if there are any levels that drive you nuts, give us feedback in the forums!

Coming very soon:

- Some smaller sets of levels to keep you occupied and entertained while we work on the bigger episodes, each with their own leaderboard.

- Drastic improvements to the editor UI, and new incentives to make and share your own levels :)

Keep on golfin'

-Miles @ Pixeljam
